bullets: Full-stack and QA engineer on a live creator-commerce platform that grew from zero to 12,700+ accounts in the seven weeks he was on it. Proposed and ran the platform's first full-stack security audit — 18 verified findings including two critical payment-integrity issues — built the gated CI/CD database-migration pipeline now used for every production release, and shipped the onboarding flow end-to-end. Next.js 16, React 19, FastAPI, Supabase, Stripe.

Built the end-to-end AI content pipeline for a legal-marketing platform — news ingestion across a curated source allow-list, LLM relevance ranking, multi-agent topic suggestion, and cited long-form generation — owning 56% of the production Python backend and merging 26 of 30 pull requests across five repositories. Flask, CrewAI, OpenAI, Perplexity, Supabase, React.

Authored an 870-line historical back-testing harness that replays a non-deterministic news pipeline day-by-day via a simulated-date parameter and measures day-over-day article overlap — creating reproducible, quantitative QA for an AI system that previously produced one unrepeatable sample per day.

Sole engineer on an executive coaching platform for a global outplacement firm — 99.4% of 1,389 commits across nine months. 124 API routes, a 21-table Postgres schema with 68 migrations and 99 row-level-security policies, three role-scoped portals, and a deep calendar-OAuth scheduling integration. Next.js 15, Supabase, serverless PDF/DOCX reporting. ~200 users.

Lead front-end and platform engineer on that firm's 12,000-user career-transition platform. Led the redesign across all 18 product sections and authored the design system; found and closed a class of authorization weaknesses across the API surface, replacing per-route checks with a guard that fails safe by default; built the repository's first CI gate. Next.js 16, Payload CMS, PostgreSQL, Fly.io.

Lead frontend engineer on a 7-week Figma-to-code redesign of a live social watch-party platform — a full visual redesign shipped into a legacy React/Redux monorepo with an Electron desktop counterpart, without a rewrite — and sole engineer on its real-time AI companion, a Gemini agent built as middleware in the app's own state layer that comments on video at exact timestamps in party chat, with no backend access.

Built the human-in-the-loop content review pipeline gating every publish on an affiliate merchandise storefront for a national consumer brand — data model, admin queue APIs, reviewer tooling, and access control at the public API boundary — plus the transactional email system and six schema migrations against live user data. React 18 + Vite, Node serverless, Supabase. Delivered and handed off for client rollout.
Built every project with Claude Code as the primary development environment.

Completed ML screening tasks that secured a major client research partnership — predictive modeling and computer-vision feature-matching pipelines, >95% model accuracy. Python, scikit-learn, OpenCV, AWS SageMaker.
Built a research-paper chat assistant with Gemini API + LangChain + ReAct framework, connected to Semantic Scholar for paper retrieval. Deployed to Hugging Face Spaces.
Established ML best practices through code reviews and documentation as team scaled from 4 to 13 engineers.

projects.title: CHULOOPA
projects.subtitle: Real-time AI drum looper · MFA Thesis
projects.description: Three-process live performance system: ChucK handles audio/MIDI/ChuGL visuals, Python runs a 4.8M-param Transformer variation engine (GPTBarPair decoder, trained on 12,085 bar pairs), and a spice detector analyzes live audio energy every 500ms to select variations in real time. Personalized KNN beatbox classifier (MFCC-13 → kick/snare/hi-hat) sends MIDI to Ableton via IAC Driver.

projects.title: tabIt
projects.subtitle: Play-along chords from any song's audio
projects.description: Paste a YouTube URL and tabIt detects the chords, key, and scales from the audio itself — then follows along karaoke-style under the video via a Chrome extension. A Python MIR engine (Demucs source separation → crema chord model on the harmonic mix, CREPE bass tracking on the isolated stem, reconciled into slash chords like A/C#) emits a chart JSON that both a React web app and an MV3 extension render. Low-confidence chords are softened, never hidden.

projects.title: ASCII Drone Synth
projects.subtitle: Gesture-controlled web synthesizer
projects.description: Browser-based gestural instrument driven by MediaPipe hand tracking at 30fps. Four-voice major chord (8 oscillators, triangle/sawtooth crossfade) with filter → chorus → stereo widener → reverb. WebGL ASCII rendering via THREE.InstancedMesh + custom GLSL shaders — each character is a GPU instance updated every frame from live webcam data.

projects.title: HAI · Head as Interface
projects.subtitle: Wearable gestural instrument
projects.description: Two HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensors (one per ear) on Arduino → serial to Max/MSP. Left sensor controls lowpass filter cutoff; right sensor controls playback speed and pitch. DSP logic in a dedicated Max/MSP abstraction with FM synthesis patch for extended sound design.

projects.title: Parallel Paths
projects.subtitle: AI × music art installation · CalArts 2024
projects.description: Debut album exhibited alongside Inbetweens — an album made in 2 weeks using Gemini for co-writing and Suno for co-production. Rule: AI provides bones, artist finalizes phrasing and adds elements. Exhibited as a listening installation at CalArts. Explores responsible AI in creative practice.

projects.title: Multi-Modal Video Analysis
projects.subtitle: Degradation-tolerant Gemini pipeline
projects.description: The video-understanding layer behind a real-time AI watch-along companion, built at Nuts and Bolts AI. Gemini handles video analysis, a scraping service pulls transcripts, and a metadata API supplies the rest — but any given video may have all, some, or none of those signals, so the analyzer selects one of three prompt variants based on what actually exists rather than failing or hallucinating around a missing transcript. Packaged for client handoff with an integration guide.
